scripts.dev:full: concurrently --names "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "yellow,blue,green" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.setup:db: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:db-push --prefix backend
